name: V987 Cassiopeiae
description: A naked-eye star 10.1 parsecs away, 83% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 10780: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.763 +/- 0.019 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 0.825 +/- 0.021

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 10780: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 5396 +/- 72

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 10780: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 99.34 +/- 0.53 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 10 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 83% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 0.763 milliarcseconds, which gives 0.825 solar radii and 5,396 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 10780: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
